title: PR-MaGIC: Prompt Refinement Via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow For In-Context Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2604.12113v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have significantly advanced broad use of image segmentation. However, SAM and its variants necessitate substantial manual effort for prompt generation and additional training for specific applications. Recent approaches address these limitations by integrating SAM into in-context (one/few shot) segmentation, enabling auto-prompting through semantic alignment between query and support images. Despite these efforts, they still generate sub-optimal prompts that degrade segmentation quality due to visual inconsistencies between support and query images. To tackle this limitation, we introduce PR-MaGIC (Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation), a training-free test-time framework that refines prompts via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder. translated_title: PR-MaGIC：基于掩码解码器梯度流的上下文分割提示词优化方法
translated_abstract: 诸如Segment Anything Model（SAM）等视觉基础模型（VFMs）极大地推动了图像分割的广泛应用。然而，SAM及其变体在生成提示词时需要大量人工操作，且需要针对特定应用进行额外的训练。近期的方法通过将SAM整合到上下文（单样本/少样本）分割中来解决这些局限性，通过查询图像与支持图像之间的语义对齐实现自动提示。尽管有这些努力，由于支持图像与查询图像之间的视觉不一致性，这些方法仍会生成次优的提示词，从而降低分割质量。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了PR-MaGIC（Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation），这是一个无需训练的测试时框架，通过源自SAM掩码解码器的梯度流来优化提示词。PR-MaGIC能够无缝集成到上下文分割框架中……
tldr: PR-MaGIC是一个无需训练的测试时框架，利用SAM掩码解码器产生的梯度流来优化上下文分割中自动生成的提示词，解决了支持图像与查询图像之间视觉不一致导致的分割质量下降问题。
en_tdlr: PR-MaGIC is a training-free test-time framework that refines auto-generated prompts in in-context segmentation via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder, addressing segmentation quality degradation caused by visual inconsistencies between support and query images.
